detect.text: Charge Start Date - Charge End Date

meta.format: Microsoft Customer Agreement invoice PDF (Details By Section: purchases and usage charges)
meta.notes: Each purchase is a product heading, a column header printed on several rows, and one row per charge period (Unit Price, Qty, Charges/Credits, Sales Tax, Tax Amount, Total including Tax). Usage charges are printed by service family (Compute, Storage...), each with its period below. The header rows are not text of the lines; the Total is split into the charge and its tax. Proved by Charges, Credits, Subtotal, Sales Tax and Total (including Tax). The note rows under a charge (license change, subscription quantity, invoice number) and the period under a usage family belong to the charge above (tree.trailer); a charge with no name of its own is the next charge of the product above.

tree.ignore: ^(Total|Unit .*|Charges/ .*|Purchases .*|Charge Start Date - Charge End Date.*|Charges Tax Amount Total.*|Section Name .*)$
